description: This PHP source file defines deprecated SOAP web service functions for SuiteCRM/SugarCRM, including user authentication, contact/lead/account management, email tracking, and search functionalities. It registers multiple SOAP methods and contains internal functions for entity retrieval and creation.

methods.name: create_session
methods.description: Creates a new user session if credentials are valid.

methods.name: end_session
methods.description: Ends a user session.

methods.name: validate_user
methods.description: Validates user credentials, sets current user context.

methods.name: add_contacts_matching_email_address
methods.description: Finds contacts matching an email and appends related entities to output list.

methods.name: add_leads_matching_email_address
methods.description: Finds leads matching an email and appends to output list.

methods.name: get_contact_relationships
methods.description: Retrieves related modules for a contact record.

methods.name: contact_by_email
methods.description: Searches contacts and leads by email addresses.

methods.name: get_contact_array
methods.description: Converts a contact bean into an array of details.

methods.name: get_user_list_array
methods.description: Converts a user bean into an array of details.

methods.name: user_list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all users.

methods.name: contact_by_search
methods.description: Searches contacts by name.

methods.name: get_lead_array
methods.description: Converts a lead bean into an array of details.

methods.name: lead_by_search
methods.description: Searches leads by name.

methods.name: get_account_array
methods.description: Converts an account bean into an array of details.

methods.name: account_by_search
methods.description: Searches accounts by name.

methods.name: get_opportunity_array
methods.description: Converts an opportunity bean into an array of details.

methods.name: opportunity_by_search
methods.description: Searches opportunities by name.

methods.name: get_bean_array
methods.description: Converts a generic bean into an array of details.

methods.name: get_case_array
methods.description: Converts a case bean into an array of details.

methods.name: bug_by_search
methods.description: Searches bugs by name.

methods.name: case_by_search
methods.description: Searches cases by name.

methods.name: track_email
methods.description: Records an email message and links it to related entities.

methods.name: create_contact
methods.description: Creates a new contact record.

methods.name: create_lead
methods.description: Creates a new lead record.

methods.name: create_account
methods.description: Creates a new account record.

methods.name: create_case
methods.description: Creates a new case record.

methods.name: create_opportunity
methods.description: Creates a new opportunity record.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a combined search across contacts, leads, accounts, cases, opportunities, and bugs.
